scripts.build: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:TEMP='D:\temp'; $env:TMP='D:\temp'; if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }; if (Test-Path Adaptix_App) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force Adaptix_App }; .\venv\Scripts\pip install pyinstaller; .\venv\Scripts\pyinstaller --noconsole --onedir --clean --distpath . --workpath D:/temp/build --add-data 'venv/Lib/site-packages/customtkinter;customtkinter/' --icon 'icon.ico' --name Adaptix_App main.py"
